sloka: इति सन्दिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा ।वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। ७.९३.१७ ॥
transliteration: iti sandiśya bahuśo muniḥ prācetasastadā ।vālmīkiḥ paramodārastūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.93.17 ॥

translations.english: Thus, having repeatedly instructed them, the highly renowned and most noble sage Valmiki, son of Prachetas, then remained silent.
